reference.title: Comparison states and row types
reference.shortdesc: Comparison rows explain whether a policy or managed preference is equal, changed, or missing on either side.

section.title: Row types
section.p: A policy row represents a Firefox Enterprise policy. A preference row represents a managed preference key and value.

section.title: Equal
section.p: Both profiles contain the setting and the compared values match.

section.title: Changed
section.p: Both profiles contain the setting, but Profile A and Profile B have different values or value details.

section.title: Missing
section.p: The setting exists on only one side. Review the profile where the value is missing before assuming the absence is intentional.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: If a state is unexpected, confirm both selected profiles, save any editor changes, and reopen Compare from the Library.
